entities.name: PMID:25444368
observations: Retrospective cohort of 30 lung transplant recipients: pretransplant MII-pH prolonged bolus clearance predicted earlier biopsy-defined acute rejection or lymphocytic bronchiolitis (HR 4.11, 95% CI 1.34–12.57, p=0.01); total distal reflux episodes (HR 4.80, p=0.02) and proximal episodes (HR 4.43, p=0.03) were also associated.

entities.name: PMID:26290637
observations: Retrospective cohort of 32 lung transplant recipients: bolus reflux exposure (HR 1.18, 95% CI 1.01–1.36), recumbent bolus exposure (HR 1.25, 1.04–1.50), and bolus clearance time (HR 1.09, 1.01–1.17) associated with early allograft injury; corresponding acid-pH measures were not significant and impedance parameters had higher ROC discrimination.
